description: developer-harness guard hooks (Codex dialect). Two layers: safety guards on every shell tool call (dangerous shell commands, protected paths) plus a protected-paths pass on apply_patch payloads (Codex file edits arrive as v4a patches in tool_input.command, tool_name `apply_patch` — https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/hooks), then commit hygiene (secrets, large files, merge markers, quality gate). Codex has no per-hook `if` narrowing, so all four commit guards read the payload themselves via hooks/scripts/lib/commit-payload.sh and pass immediately unless the command is an actual `git commit` invocation; a payload with no extractable command still scans, so git pre-commit use keeps working. Declared in .codex-plugin/plugin.json; deliberately NOT named hooks/hooks.json — see hooks/README.md. instruction-scan.sh, agents-md-budget.sh, and done-authority-gate.sh are documented opt-ins and are intentionally absent here.
